-- Locations the current user may view, from their Grafana teams (id 0 = All Locations).
-- can_view_patients: an admin or a patients team grants it; aggregated teams give dashboards only.
-- Team names (<type> = patients | aggregated, <location> = lowercased name, spaces -> _):
--   heart360tk_view_<type>_<location>          location and below; nothing if the name is not unique
--   heart360tk_view_<type>_ALL                 everything
--   heart360tk_<level>_view_<type>_<location>  legacy: location at that level and below
--   heart360tk_<level>_view_<type>_ALL         legacy: every location at that level and below
-- All Locations (0) needs nationwide access: admin, a new _ALL team, or a level-1 legacy _ALL team.
WITH my_teams AS (
  SELECT t.name, ty.type
  FROM grafana_schema.team_member tm
  JOIN grafana_schema.team t ON t.id = tm.team_id
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('patients'), ('aggregated')) AS ty(type)
  WHERE tm.user_id = ${__user.id}
),
slugs AS (
  SELECT ou.id, ou.level, replace(lower(trim(ou.name)), ' ', '_') AS slug
  FROM heart360tk_schema.org_units ou
),
all_access AS (
  SELECT 0 AS level, true AS patients
  FROM grafana_schema."user" u
  WHERE u.id = ${__user.id} AND u.is_admin
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 0, mt.type = 'patients'
  FROM my_teams mt
  WHERE mt.name = 'heart360tk_view_' || mt.type || '_ALL'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT hc.level, mt.type = 'patients'
  FROM my_teams mt
  JOIN heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc
    ON mt.name = 'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_' || mt.type || '_ALL'
),
granted AS (
  SELECT MIN(s.id) AS id, mt.type = 'patients' AS patients
  FROM my_teams mt
  JOIN slugs s ON mt.name = 'heart360tk_view_' || mt.type || '_' || s.slug
  GROUP BY mt.name, mt.type
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.id, mt.type = 'patients'
  FROM my_teams mt
  JOIN slugs s ON true
  LEFT JOIN heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc ON hc.level = s.level
  WHERE mt.name = 'heart360tk_' || COALESCE(hc.var_name, 'level_' || s.level) || '_view_' || mt.type || '_' || s.slug
),
access AS (
  SELECT x.id, bool_or(x.patients) AS can_view_patients
  FROM (
    SELECT 0 AS id, aa.patients FROM all_access aa WHERE aa.level <= 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.id, aa.patients FROM slugs s JOIN all_access aa ON s.level >= aa.level
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lin.org_unit_id, g.patients
    FROM heart360tk_schema.org_unit_lineage lin
    JOIN granted g ON g.id = lin.ancestor_id
  ) x
  GROUP BY x.id
)
SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(a.id || ':' || CASE WHEN a.can_view_patients THEN '1' ELSE '0' END, ',' ORDER BY a.id), '') AS user_access
FROM access a

list.definition:
-- ${UserAccess} = the user's locations as <org unit id>:<1 if patient-level access> (0 = All Locations).
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM unnest(string_to_array(NULLIF('${UserAccess}', ''), ',')) a
  WHERE split_part(a, ':', 1) = '0'
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

list.definition:
-- ${UserAccess} = the user's locations as <org unit id>:<1 if patient-level access> (0 = All Locations).
SELECT COALESCE(
  (SELECT ou.id::text
   FROM unnest(string_to_array(NULLIF('${UserAccess}', ''), ',')) a
   JOIN heart360tk_schema.org_units ou ON ou.id::text = split_part(a, ':', 1)
   ORDER BY ou.level ASC, ou.name ASC
   LIMIT 1),
  ''
)
